title: Seven Palms Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, expansive living spaces are crafted for gathering and entertaining, featuring soaring ceilings, a chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances, and beautifully appointed dining and lounge areas. The home comfortably accommodates large groups with multiple king suites, custom bunk rooms, and inviting entertainment spaces across every level. Guests can enjoy amenities designed for the ultimate coastal getaway, including a six-seater golf cart, six adult bicycles, and complimentary seasonal beach setups. With easy beach access just a short walk away and every detail designed for comfort and style, this exceptional residence offers an unforgettable setting for a luxurious Gulf Coast escape.
